out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Temp Reached within 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding within a sufficient time of 2 hours or less: commercially processed potato soup (124 F) (3hr) in the HH steam well (left).
violations.corrective_action: Reheating food for hot holding shall be done rapidly, within 2 hours to prevent growth of pathogens. CDI: THE FOOD WAS DISCARDED. EHS RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed chemical spray bottles stored on top of single service gloves and next to hot sauce packets.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: PIC relocated the chemical spray bottles.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed boxed drinks in the dry storage closet and packaged bottles of mayo stored in the prep room stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ENSURE THE FOODS ARE NOT STORED ON THE FLOOR BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FAUCET OF THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE WAREWASHING AREA TO BE LEAKING WHEN TURNED OFF.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. FIX THE HANDWASHING SINK SO IT DOES NOT LEAK WITHIN THREE MONTHS, BY DECEMBER 22ND.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Observed expired test kit for chlorine in the facility, ( kit expired September 2022)
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. Person in charge ordered a new test kit

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use, RAID, were observed in the facility during the time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC threw out can of RAID

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: EHS observed storage of paper storage grocery store bags and personal items in a pile next to the ice machine and used cardboards boxes being stored under the rear handsink and three compartment sink contributing to harborage conditions.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. PIC removed and recycled paper bags and cardboard boxes during inspection.

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: EHS observed two dead cockroaches on pest control traps near the hand sink and ice machine in the back kitchen that were not removed from premises.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. PIC removed cockroaches and called exterminator for service after inspection.
